verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents itself as exposing its capabilities through a single API, and the MCP layer that wraps the API can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and search, which are the same core actions the docs show in the default web interface. Nothing in the evidence explicitly states UI/API parity, and Cloud-console actions such as setting up a project have no documented API equivalent; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404. missing for 10: explicit statement of UI-to-API parity, API coverage of Cloud project/account management, a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
